2607.02632.title: QuantFlow: A Federated Mamba-Based Post-Transformer Foundation Model for Time-Series Forecasting
2607.02632.paper_summary: Time-series forecasting supports decisions in finance, en-ergy, transportation, public health, and industrial monitoring. Recent foundation models improve transfer across forecast-ing tasks, but many depend on centralized data and Trans-former attention, which restricts their use for long, high-di-mensional, and privacy-sensitive signals. This paper presents QuantFlow, a probabilistic forecasting framework that com-bines inverted sequence embedding, bidirectional Mamba state-space decoders, quantile regression, and federated learning. Each variable is embedded over the complete ob-servation window, processed in forward and reverse direc-tions, and projected to five conditional quantiles. TSMixup expands temporal diversity through Dirichlet-weighted inter-polation while preserving sequence structure. Experiments cover cryptocurrency, traffic, electricity, Electricity Trans-former Temperature, influenza, and weather data. QuantFlow obtains mean squared errors of 0.2834 on ETTm1 and 0.2218 on Weather, and a 20-client non-IID deployment retains use-ful accuracy after three communication rounds without cen-tralizing raw records. The results indicate that selective state-space modelling is a promising basis for scalable, uncer-tainty-aware, and privacy-conscious time-series prediction, while also revealing limitations on irregular epidemiological signals and long-horizon generalization.
2607.02632.paper_summary_zh: 時間序列預測支持金融、能源、交通、公共健康和工業監控中的決策。最近的基礎模型改善了預測任務之間的轉移，但許多模型依賴於集中數據和Transformer注意力，這限制了它們在長期、高維度和隱私敏感信號中的使用。本文提出了QuantFlow，一種結合了反向序列嵌入、雙向Mamba狀態空間解碼器、分位數回歸和聯邦學習的概率預測框架。每個變量在完整的觀察窗口中嵌入，並在正向和反向方向上處理，然後投影到五個條件分位數上。TSMixup通過Dirichlet加權插值擴展時間多樣性，同時保留序列結構。實驗涵蓋了加密貨幣、交通、電力、電力Transformer溫度、流感和氣象數據。QuantFlow在ETTm1上獲得了0.2834的均方誤差，在Weather上獲得了0.2218，並且在20客戶的非IID部署中，在三輪通信後保持了有用的準確性，而無需集中原始記錄。結果表明，選擇性狀態空間建模是可擴展、不確定性意識和隱私意識的時間序列預測的有希望的基礎，同時也揭示了對不規則流行病信號和長期預測的局限性。
